cost_model_checks.detail: All 96 rows use distinct per-case cwd, HOME, and TMPDIR paths, run in frozen serial order with no overlap, launch exactly one solver process, and report retained_state_detected=false. The runner refuses a pre-existing process directory, uses no shared state argument, and checks for unexpected files outside each fresh HOME/TMPDIR.

Each direct process emits a fresh factor-base and relation/rank receipt and completes verification before exit. No target batch, shared factor base, relation log, checkpoint, or retained solver process appears. Checkout/build/toolchain work is excluded from ratios and preserved separately with commands, elapsed time, CPU, and RSS; it is not represented as per-target cost.

Every direct and rho child has RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1. Every direct child reports query_parallel_threads=1 and parallel_support_expansion_threads=0; both support flags are disabled. Every arm reports the aarch64_pmull multiplication and squaring backend from the common port.

Every child has per-PID os.wait4 user/system CPU and ru_maxrss, plus successful proc_pid_rusage physical-footprint samples. The 8 GiB limit is truthfully a cooperative sampled cap, not an OS hard cap; all sample counts are positive and no cap was observed. Sampling can miss a between-sample peak.
